 Azkena Rock Festival 
 Azkena Rock 2027 announces its day-by-day line-up: Marilyn Manson and Slash on Thursday, Patti Smith and Wilco on Friday and Bad Religion on Saturday
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 18 Nov 2026, 13:30 
 A 3-minute read 
 Óscar L. Tejeda / Azkena Rock Festival 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Marilyn Manson and Slash open Azkena Rock 2027 on Thursday 17 June , with John Garcia and Rival Sons on the same day. 
 Friday 18 is the longest day on the bill : Patti Smith Quartet, Wilco, 16 Horsepower, Billy Bragg, Billy Talent and The Waterboys, among thirteen names on the main stages. 
 Bad Religion close the 25th anniversary on Saturday 19 , alongside Dave Alvin, Beth Hart, Michael Monroe playing Hanoi Rocks and Cala Vento. 
 Day tickets are on sale at a promotional price until 3 December : €60 for Thursday and €75 for Friday or Saturday, plus fees; the three-day pass costs €175. 
 Azkena Rock Festival has now assigned a day to every concert of its 25th anniversary. On Tuesday 17 November, the Vitoria-Gasteiz festival published the day-by-day split of a line-up of around 60 artists, who will fill Mendizabala on Thursday 17, Friday 18 and Saturday 19 June 2027 . The split also brings day tickets , at a promotional price until 3 December.
 Festival guide 
 Azkena Rock Festival 2027 
 17–19 Jun 2027 · Mendizabala, Vitoria-Gasteiz 
 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 As well as the main stages, the festival brings back its two spaces with their own programming: the Trashville tent, dedicated to garage, rockabilly and the rawest rock'n'roll, and the Strawhouse stage, for roots music.
 Thursday 17 June: Marilyn Manson and Slash
 The first day is headlined by Marilyn Manson and Slash ft. Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators , who return to Vitoria-Gasteiz. That summer Manson also has another date at a Spanish festival, Rock Imperium in Cartagena , in early July.
 Main stages: Marilyn Manson, Slash ft. Myles Kennedy & The Conspirators, John Garcia, Rival Sons, The Clayton, Parker Barrow and The Southern River Band.
 Trashville: The Cyborgs, Dead Elvis & His One Man Grave, Les Greene, Reverend Beat-Man & Milan Slick and The Urban Voodoo Machine.
 Strawhouse: Peter Bruntnell, Deke Dickerson and Jerron "Blind Boy" Paxton.
 John Garcia is the original voice of Kyuss, and The Clayton provide the local contingent with their high-energy rock.
 Friday 18 June: Patti Smith Quartet and Wilco
 Friday is the day with the most names. Patti Smith returns to Mendizabala as a quartet, following her 2022 performance, and shares the day with Wilco and the comeback of 16 Horsepower .
 Main stages: Patti Smith Quartet, Wilco, 16 Horsepower, Billy Bragg, Billy Talent, Nick Lowe & Los Straitjackets, The Waterboys, The Bird Experience, Cherry Poppin' Daddies, BARRRK, The Drones, Girls Against Boys and Super400.
 Trashville: Bárbara y Rey, Blind Rage & Violence, Demented Are Go, Old Time Spooks and Los Straitjackets.
 Strawhouse: The Complete Recordings of Hezekiah Procter, Hayseed Dixie, Joana Serrat and Tulsa.
 According to the festival, Super400 return to Mendizabala two decades after their previous visit, and local representation comes from BARRRK.
 The day-by-day poster for the 25th anniversary. Image: Azkena Rock Festival Saturday 19 June: Bad Religion close the anniversary
 The closing slot goes to Bad Religion , on a Saturday of punk, Americana and glam. Michael Monroe will run through the Hanoi Rocks classics, and the Spanish scene is represented by Cala Vento and Marte Lasarte.
 Main stages: Bad Religion, Dave Alvin & The Guilty Ones, American Aquarium, Beth Hart, Michael Monroe plays Hanoi Rocks, Twin Temple, The Bevis Frond, Bratakus, Cala Vento, Cockney Rejects, Foxy Shazam, Marte Lasarte and Old 97's.
 Trashville: The Bank Robbers, Bob Log III, Micky y Los Colosos del Ritmo, Tear Dungeon and Wild Billy Childish & CTMF.
 Strawhouse: Dave Hause, Lilly Hiatt and Nick Lowe, who also plays on Friday with Los Straitjackets.
 Day tickets and passes: prices
 With the day-by-day split, the festival has put single-day tickets on sale at a promotional price, valid until 3 December at 23:59 . These are the prices on the official website, to which booking fees are added:
 Thursday 17: €60.
 Friday 18: €75.
 Saturday 19: €75.
 Three-day pass: €175.
 Youth pass for ages 15 to 24, or under 30 with a Gazte Txartela or EYCA card: €135.
 Alongside the promotional price, the website shows €79 and warns that the price of day tickets will change on 3 December. Passes can be paid in instalments, in three payments. Tickets are sold via the festival's tickets page .
 We explained how the promo pass went from €150 to €175 in our story on the Azkena 2027 pass , and the full festival is on the Azkena Rock Festival page . If you are planning your calendar, Azkena clashes with other events we cover in the 2027 festivals that overlap , and the rest of June is in the April to June 2027 festival calendar .
 Sources: official Azkena Rock Festival press release "Azkena Rock Festival reveals the day-by-day line-up for its 25th anniversary" (17 November 2026), day-by-day poster and tickets page on azkenarockfestival.com, consulted on 18 November 2026.
